why: The neighbours-coexistence item mixes border and space deals with truce-like non-destruction and harmony pacts, making settling space hard to separate from ending a fight.

why.T3-044: Outsider led by the canvas icon asks what the community is, matching recruiting canvas visitors rather than members finding their own mark.

why.T3-004: The item repeatedly settles what the tree should look like—mock-ups, colours, winky eye, roots/branches/leaves—matching design work rather than mere building.
why.T3-041: It also repeatedly proposes or builds extensions—new big tree, grass, forest, expanding right—so the enlargement/adding-pieces gate is independently satisfied.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 alone would carry the redesign and mock-up work but not the repeated practice of enlarging and extending the tree into new pieces and surrounding garden.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The item also repeatedly proposes and builds extensions—new big tree, grass, forest, branches/leaves—satisfying T3-041's enlargement/adding-pieces gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-041 would be dropped if forced to one; the extension/enlargement practice would be lost.

why.T3-031: Joke likening damaged Grey face to Undertale is the room's running in-joke, not griefing done for fun or repair.

why.T3-117: All three concepts respond to closure—lamenting a pixel, declaring defence over, mourning an almost-perfect finish—so the canvas end is registered.

why.T3-028: Script changed to draw automatically is running a script for the work, not arguing fairness or glitching the limit.

why.T3-088: Unlimited-block glitch used to place more pixels satisfies placing beyond the limit, not ordinary cooldown coping.

why.T3-086: Flaggy Flag versus Nail and Gear is the community's own internal flag quarrel fought in pixels, so it carries the sub's quarrel rather than a generic in-joke or external rival attack.

why.T3-105: Sharing the timelapse moment the HI Corner is born keeps the finished work as a record.
why.T3-057: Proposing the blemished final art as next episode's custom artwork reuses the canvas work in another medium, beyond a record.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 would carry the timelapse as a record but not the proposal to repurpose the blemished final image as the next episode's custom artwork.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0392473 uses the completed corner as episode artwork, a reuse in another medium satisfying T3-057's remaking-canvas-art-elsewhere gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-057 would be dropped if forced to one; the new-use/episode-artwork aspect would be lost.
